title: The Hour of Mercy
description: Recall Christ’s Passion at 3pm with Divine Mercy prayers · ~5 min

mercy_hour_prayer.text: Lord Jesus, on the Cross you poured out life for the world. At the hour of your death, mercy opened wide for every soul. As we recall that hour now, we ask: let your mercy flow upon us, and upon all for whom we pray, in this hour and at the hour of our death.
mercy_hour_prayer.source: The Diary of St. Faustina (short invocations)

mercy_hour_repetition.text: O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You.
mercy_hour_repetition.source: The Diary of St. Faustina (short invocations)
